description: The dependency updates of owt-stack and its apps, run by the self-hosted Renovate (.github/workflows/renovate.yml): crates, npm packages, action and reusable-workflow pins, the owt-stack release pins, and the base images (base-images.json). Updates are fix(deps) pull requests to main, which release.yml and release-please turn into patch releases; action pins are one ci(deps) pull request a month. Minor and patch crate and npm updates come grouped per ecosystem, majors one by one, after a minimum release age, twice a week. Nothing automerges except base-images.json's digest-only bumps.

packageRules.description: Third-party crates and npm packages wait three days, so a yanked or compromised release is caught upstream first.
Third-party actions wait three days as well.

Action pins change CI, not what an app ships: one ci(deps) pull request a month (the first Monday), every update type together, which releases nothing and builds no image. Action pins never automerge; a job's container image moves by digest under the next rule. The digest keeps its `# vX.Y.Z` comment, which Renovate rewrites with it. The owt-stack rule below takes the reusable workflows out of this group.

A job's container image in a workflow (`container:` or `image:` pinned by digest): a digest-only bump (same tag, new digest) automerges after its checks once the digest is 24 hours old, like a base image, on the twice-weekly schedule. A tag change still waits in the monthly actions group for review.

An owt-stack release: every crate pinned by git tag in Cargo.toml, the stylesheet's github:onewaytek/owt-stack#vX.Y.Z in package.json and the reusable workflows pinned by commit move together in one pull request, whatever the update type, as fix(deps) (the workflows ship with the release the app adopts). Twice a week like the crates, not monthly like the other action pins. No minimum age: owt-stack's own releases are adopted as they come.
